title: potentilla cinerea subsp. tommasiniana
intro: Potentilla cinerea subsp. tommasiniana, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil or Tommasin's Cinquefoil, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla cinerea subsp. tommasiniana include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic agent, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, arthritis, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are known to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
